# Wald Inference Core

Repository: https://github.com/reblocke/wald-inference-core
Distribution: wald-inference
Import: wald_inference
License: MIT
Maintainer: Brian Locke (@reblocke)

Purpose:
Pure-Python numerical utilities for documented one-parameter normal/Wald reconstruction,
compatibility, normalized relative support, selected-claim, Type S/M, and precision calculations.

Start with:
- README.md
- docs/SCIENTIFIC_SCOPE.md
- docs/API.md
- docs/VALIDATION.md
- docs/MIGRATION_PROVENANCE.md

Important constraints:
- This package does not recover exact fitted-model likelihood.
- Type S/M quantities are repeated-study operating characteristics, not posterior probabilities.
- Ratio measures are evaluated on the log working scale.
- Serializable calculation outputs use finite numbers or None; selection-rule intervals use
  infinities only as mathematical open-tail sentinels.
- Browser contracts, UI rendering, exports, telemetry, and persistence are out of scope.
- Numerical behavior is tied to the tagged pre-split baseline and its committed parity corpus.
